comment: Basic Training boost leg (F1). P6 sits beyond the barrier at (150,20); the beacon's depth-failed ghost pass reads through the wall, teaching that the dimmer column means 'on the other side'. The straight leg to P6 crosses the barrier collider on purpose - the LOS content test whitelists this leg (jump_jets step), and the arrow still points at the corner the re-router picks if the pilot walks instead of boosting.
